question: Does the predecessor live transcript plus current-head test coverage sufficiently prove this expanded transaction, or must this exact head show a live gateway commit, rollback, and shutdown race before merge?
rationale: The patch is broad and compatibility-sensitive, but the remaining blocker is evidentiary rather than a concrete code defect; only a maintainer can explicitly accept inherited proof for the expanded lifecycle surface.

options.title: Require exact-head live proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live transcript or recording covering successful atomic reload, forced rollback, auth/secret coherence, and shutdown during reload before merging.

options.title: Accept inherited proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the predecessor hooks/cron transcript plus current-head focused tests as sufficient for the added transaction surfaces.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head live proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted live transcript or recording covering successful atomic reload, forced rollback, auth/secret coherence, and shutdown during reload before merging.
